sections.heading: Welcome to QingYu
paragraphs: QingYu is an independently maintained open-source notes application by appdev. It is modified from SiYuan, but it is not an official SiYuan release and is not affiliated with, authorized, endorsed, or sponsored by its operators.

sections.heading: Workspace and backups
paragraphs: Documents, settings, and logs are primarily kept in the local workspace you select. Do not let a sync-drive client concurrently rewrite the live workspace, and create independent backups you can verify.
bullets: Exit the application and let writes finish before copying a workspace.
Keep at least one important backup outside the live workspace.

sections.heading: Editing, organization, and search
paragraphs: QingYu organizes documents with a block editor. You can create document hierarchies and use tags, links, and search to find content.
bullets: Practice imports, renames, and moves on non-critical documents first.

sections.heading: Import, export, and compatibility
paragraphs: QingYu continues to read .sy data and legacy siyuan:// block links for existing-data compatibility. Newly generated product links use qingyu://. Compatibility does not mean that upstream services are provided.
bullets: Spot-check text, attachments, math, and embedded content after export.

sections.heading: Privacy, security, and networking
paragraphs: QingYu is centered on a local workspace. Data may be sent to services you select when you enable synchronization, network resources, publishing, MCP, WebDAV, S3, or third-party extensions. You decide whether to disclose logs by exporting or sending them.
bullets: Do not send passwords, keys, or unnecessary private content in feedback.
Read an external service's privacy policy before using it.

sections.heading: Plugins, themes, and third parties
paragraphs: Plugins, themes, and external links are controlled by their authors or providers and may access content, networking, or local capabilities. Review origin, permissions, and update history before installation.
bullets: The QingYu developer does not control third-party services.
Disable recently installed extensions first when troubleshooting.

sections.heading: Open-source license and support
paragraphs: QingYu is distributed under AGPL-3.0. Copyright in upstream code and rights in third-party components remain with their respective owners. appdev independently builds, distributes, and supports QingYu.

sections.heading: Legal documents
paragraphs: Read QingYu's own Privacy Policy and User Agreement before use. They do not adopt terms for any upstream online service.
